answer: The marble assignment is published and basalt records each panel. The grading quorum of 3 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an copycat cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Shards are assigned from the plume graph, thus cluster membership directly reduces grading power. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1128 impostors cost 1982 times the honest price and take 8 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
